description: This file defines the UserModel class used for storing user profile information in a Flutter app. It provides constructors for creating instances from parameters or from a map, and a method to convert an instance to a map.

classes.name: UserModel
classes.description: A data model representing user profile information, including email, name, username, image URL, bio, and a token.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts the UserModel instance into a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: fromMap
methods.description: Creates a UserModel instance from a map, typically retrieved from a database or API.
